AI Notes.value: Solo graphic designer and studio founder (Kevin Hogger Visual Services) based in Zurich, Switzerland. Started with a 4-year graphic design apprenticeship at ~15, then studied Industrial Design at ZHdK Zurich University of the Arts; worked for a Zurich/New York architect before going independent in 2018. Disciplines: visual identity systems, graphic design, signage, imagemaking, packaging, publication design. Clients include cafes, hotels, jewellery brands and drinks brands; work realized in CH, USA, Turkey, Australia, Sri Lanka. Co-founder of Urban Lemonade identity (with Jalscha Romer) and of Mockup.Maison (with Michael Kennedy). iF Design Award 2026 for Museumsquartier Bern identity. Instagram confirmed as @kevinhoegger via his own website footer and Google snippet. LinkedIn confirmed at ch.linkedin.com/in/kevin-hoegger-089a27275. Work Status: Studio (operates as independent studio; The Brand Identity Freelancers series, kevinhoegger.com, itsnicethat.com all confirm independent since 2018; LinkedIn current). Seniority: mid-to-senior level, ~8 yrs independent; handles full briefs from strategy to delivery, all solo. Autonomy 4: takes full ownership of projects, sole founder, works independently with clients globally; capacity note: says he takes few projects per year, so scheduling may be a factor.
